item.title: About me
item.description: I have now (mostly) left the university and now work for Siemens, doing things very close to what I was doing before. I still have some papers in the pipeling, so you can find my papers, I did some rewiews (and might still do if I am interested) teach, but also do some administrative tasks for the university.
